blank.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_raw.source_lines WHERE parse_status = 'blank' ORDER BY source_line_number

short.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_raw.source_lines WHERE parse_status = 'short' ORDER BY source_line_number

extra.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_raw.source_lines WHERE parse_status = 'extra' ORDER BY source_line_number

step_4_2_customer_ids.expected_form: exactly five ASCII digits, as in the supplied source

missing.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NULL OR customer_id = '' ORDER BY source_line_number

wrong_form.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT regexp_full_match(customer_id, '[0-9]{5}') ORDER BY source_line_number

unparseable.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE parse_status = 'four_fields' AND transaction_date IS NULL ORDER BY source_line_number

out_of_observation_window.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE transaction_date < DATE '1997-01-01' OR transaction_date > DATE '1998-06-30' ORDER BY source_line_number

step_4_4_cohort_entry.definition: earliest recorded purchase per customer in 1997-01-01 through 1997-03-31
step_4_4_cohort_entry.all_source_lines_query: WITH first_dates AS (SELECT customer_id, min(transaction_date) AS first_date FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT s.source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions s JOIN first_dates f ON s.customer_id = f.customer_id AND s.transaction_date = f.first_date WHERE f.first_date < DATE '1997-01-01' OR f.first_date > DATE '1997-03-31' ORDER BY s.source_line_number

zero.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE cd_count = 0 ORDER BY source_line_number

negative.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE cd_count < 0 ORDER BY source_line_number

fractional_string.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE regexp_full_match(cd_count_raw, '[+-]?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+') ORDER BY source_line_number

other_unparseable.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE parse_status = 'four_fields' AND cd_count IS NULL AND NOT coalesce(regexp_full_match(cd_count_raw, '[+-]?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+'), false) ORDER BY source_line_number

zero.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE transaction_dollars = 0 ORDER BY source_line_number

negative.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE transaction_dollars < 0 ORDER BY source_line_number

non_cent_precision_string.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE regexp_full_match(dollar_value_raw, '[+-]?[0-9]+\.[0-9]{3,}') ORDER BY source_line_number

other_unparseable.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE parse_status = 'four_fields' AND transaction_dollars IS NULL AND NOT coalesce(regexp_full_match(dollar_value_raw, '[+-]?[0-9]+\.[0-9]{3,}'), false) ORDER BY source_line_number

exact_four_field_values.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM (SELECT source_line_number, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id_raw, transaction_date_raw, cd_count_raw, dollar_value_raw) AS n FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions) WHERE n > 1 ORDER BY source_line_number

same_customer_and_date.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM (SELECT source_line_number, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, transaction_date) AS n FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions) WHERE n > 1 ORDER BY source_line_number

step_4_9_repeated_looking_records.interpretation: No order ID exists; neither pattern proves duplicated transactions.

step_4_10_profile.large_cd_threshold: 10 or more CDs on one source line

large_cd_rows.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE cd_count >= 10 ORDER BY source_line_number

step_4_10_profile.large_dollar_threshold: 200.00 dollars or more on one source line

large_dollar_rows.all_source_lines_query: SELECT source_line_number FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE transaction_dollars >= 200.00 ORDER BY source_line_number

missing_calendar_dates.all_dates_query: SELECT calendar_day::DATE FROM generate_series(DATE '1997-01-01', DATE '1998-06-30', INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS days(calendar_day) WHERE calendar_day::DATE NOT IN (SELECT transaction_date FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE transaction_date IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY calendar_day

missing_customer_ids_between_00001_and_2.all_ids_query: SELECT lpad(cast(n AS VARCHAR), 5, '0') AS missing_customer_id FROM generate_series(1, 23570) AS numbers(n) WHERE lpad(cast(n AS VARCHAR), 5, '0') NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM cdnow_analysis.stg_cdnow_transactions WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY n

step_4_10_profile.gap_interpretation: A gap would be a profile finding, not proof of a bad record or missing purchase.
